title: 第19章 进化之课
novel_title: 御兽仙朝：我能设计进化形态
content_zh:
天还没大亮。

    稻花村到黑土县之间的山路上，便有一个单薄的人影，在山路上一深一浅地往前走。

    那是罗影。

    他离开的时候，东方的天空还没有泛出鱼肚白。

    从村里到县城，得走两个多时辰。

    他如果不趁着天没亮的时候就上路，等到太阳升起来之后再走，今天这一节课就会被耽误了。

    山路很曲折，很难走，而且也没有什么能照亮的地方。

    刚才在陡坡上，他一脚踩到了路旁虚土里，整个人往前栽了一把，膝盖重重磕在一块凸起的石头上。

    他闷哼了一声，从地上爬起来。

    借着熹微的晨光，低下头看了看。

    裤子破了道伤口，膝盖上正渗着一片暗红，火辣辣地疼。

    罗影只是伸出手来，粗鲁地一抹那血。

    又抬起脚，往前走。

    这点皮肉伤，他顾不上。

    他得赶路。

    其实，去县城，并不一定要这样摸黑着走。

    每日卯时，赵老六的【拉车牛】也跟着往县城送货。

    搭他这趟车，省脚程又稳当。

    不过要五十文。

    罗影并没有去等那班车。

    他想起那半碟子已经吃了六天、就着糙米咽下去的胡萝卜...

    想起这十几年来，爹和大哥是怎么一个铜板、一个铜板，从牙缝里抠出他那笔束脩的。

    如今，在交了一两银租牛后...

    他这一家子，全身上下，都拿不出来五十文。

    可说来也怪。

    走在一条漆黑的山路之上，膝盖明明已经被血浸透了...

    但是罗影的眼睛里，并没有看到半分的苦楚。

    满满的，全是光。

    因为今日。

    正是开讲【御兽进化论】的日子。

    他低下头看了一下自己的右手。

    手背上，那【赴死蚁】的图案，正温温地贴着他的皮肤。

    从那晚开始，他和小玄把话说开了，小玄之后再也不曾躲过他。

    今天这节课上，如果小玄可以进化的话...

    罗影想到这里，不自觉地加快了脚步。

    想到家里那头自断双角、寿命减半的老黑，再想起大哥罗川那一年比一年更驼的脊背...

    只要小玄争气。

    这个家，就有指望了。

    ...

    等到天刚蒙蒙亮的时候，罗影便来到了县城，并且进入了潜鳞书院，在这里找到了一间名为七号的教室。

    李子诚早就到了，正搓着手在门口等他。

    一抬眼就看见罗影裤腿上暗红色的一块，李子诚的脸色顿时一沉，几步就迎了上来。
content_en:
It's not bright yet.

On the mountain road between Daohua Village and Heitu County, there is a thin figure walking forward on the mountain road.

That's Luo Ying.

When he left, the eastern sky had not yet turned white.

It takes more than two hours to walk from the village to the county seat.

If he didn't hit the road before dawn and wait until the sun rose before leaving, today's class would have been delayed.

The mountain road is very winding and difficult to walk, and there is nothing to illuminate.

Just now on the steep slope, he stepped on the empty soil on the side of the road. He fell forward and hit his knees heavily on a raised stone.

He groaned and got up from the ground.

Taking advantage of the faint morning light, I lowered my head and took a look.

There was a cut on his pants, and there was a dark red ooze on his knees, which was burning and painful.

Luo Ying just stretched out his hand and wiped the blood roughly.

He lifted his feet again and walked forward.

He couldn't care less about this little flesh wound.

He had to hurry.

In fact, going to the county seat does not necessarily mean walking in the dark like this.

At nine o'clock every day, Zhao Laoliu's [cart-pulling oxen] also goes to the county town to deliver goods.

Take this ride with him to save travel time and be safe.

But it costs fifty coins.

Luo Ying did not wait for the bus.

He thought of the half plate of carrots he had eaten for six days, swallowed with brown rice...

I remembered how my father and eldest brother spent more than ten years digging out his pen bundle from the gap between their teeth with one coin after another.

Now, after paying one tael of silver to rent the cattle...

His entire family couldn't afford fifty coins.

But that's strange.

Walking on a dark mountain road, my knees were obviously soaked in blood...

But there was no pain in Luo Ying's eyes.

Full of light.

Because today.

It's the day to start the lecture on "Evolutionary Theory of Beast Control".

He lowered his head and looked at his right hand.

On the back of his hand, the pattern of "Dead Ant" was touching his skin warmly.

From that night on, he and Xiao Xuan started talking, and Xiao Xuan never avoided him again.

In today's class, if Xiao Xuan can evolve...

Luo Ying thought of this and speeded up his pace unconsciously.

I think of Lao Hei at home, who cut off his horns and had his lifespan halved, and then I think of my elder brother Luo Chuan, whose back is getting hunchier every year...

As long as Xiaoxuan strives for success.

There is hope for this family.

...

When it was dawn, Luo Ying arrived at the county town and entered Qianlin Academy, where he found a classroom named No. 7.

Li Zicheng had arrived a long time ago and was waiting for him at the door while rubbing his hands.

As soon as he looked up, he saw a dark red patch on Luo Ying's trouser leg. Li Zicheng's face suddenly darkened and he walked up to him in a few steps.
